user.title: Set up TIPSA
user.description: Enter the postal code your parcels are delivered to. TIPSA checks it against every parcel, so it has to be the recipient's postal code. You add parcels after setup, and only need their 22-digit tracking code.

data_description.postal_code: e.g. 28001. Spanish postal codes are five digits.

abort.already_configured: A TIPSA hub for this postal code is already set up.

error.invalid_postcode: Enter a valid postal code, e.g. 28001.

data_description.add: Enter the 22-digit TIPSA tracking code to start tracking it. A parcel delivered to a different postal code can be entered as code@postcode.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.tracking_codes: A TIPSA tracking code is 22 digits. A parcel delivered to a different postal code than this hub's can be added as code@postcode.

error.invalid_tracking_code: A TIPSA tracking code is 22 digits long. The shorter waybill number on its own is not enough.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.
error.invalid_postcode: Enter a valid postal code, e.g. 28001.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its 22-digit TIPSA tracking code.

postal_code.name: Postal code
postal_code.description: Delivery postal code. Picks the hub when several are set up. With a single hub, a postal code matching no hub is used for this parcel only.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its TIPSA tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The TIPSA tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
